UI.metadataDescription: A source-attributed encyclopedia of Formula 1 history since 1950.
UI.homeLead: Meet the drivers, teams and circuits behind Formula 1. Choose a season and follow the Grand Prix results.
UI.homeSeasons: Championship calendars, circuits and results since the first season in 1950.
UI.homeLineage: Constructors and entrants are distinct identities. Historical relationships are published after separate source review.
UI.timeMachineHome: See how a driver’s teams or a constructor’s line-up changed between two seasons.
UI.homeSources: The F1DB release, checksum and statistical limitations. The archive is not updated live.
UI.timeMachineLead: Which teams did a driver race for? Who drove for a constructor? Compare two seasons through their recorded race results.
UI.timeMachineSearchPlaceholder: Search by name or F1DB identifier
UI.timeMachineChooseEntity: Start with a driver or constructor, then choose two seasons from their recorded history.
UI.timeMachineObservedOnly: Based on race results in this archive.
UI.timeMachineLimitations: These records do not establish contracts, official starts, team transfers or constructor succession. Missing imported records do not prove an association never existed. Constructors and championship entrants are separate identities.
UI.timeMachineAddedNote: Recorded in {year}; no matching result in the earlier season.
UI.timeMachineRemovedNote: Recorded in {year}; no matching result in the later season.
UI.timeMachineUnchangedNote: The same driver and constructor appear together in both seasons.
UI.timeMachineNoRecordedAssociation: No race results for this connection in this season. A missing record is not proof of absence.
UI.timeMachineNoAssociations: No race results connect this subject to a driver or constructor in either selected season. Try one of the seasons above.
UI.timeMachineProvenance: Counts come from imported main-race result rows. Result entries and distinct races are different measures; neither means official starts. The archive may be incomplete.
UI.timeMachineInvalidYear: Enter two whole season years from 1950 to 2200.
UI.timeMachineSameYear: Choose two different seasons to compare.
UI.timeMachineOrderError: The earlier season must come before the later season.
UI.timeMachineInvalidEntity: Choose a valid driver or constructor from the search results.
UI.timeMachineUnavailable: Time Machine data is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
UI.driversLead: Find a familiar name or discover a career. Explore the races, teams and seasons behind every driver.
UI.constructorsLead: Meet the constructors behind the cars. Follow their drivers, seasons and Grand Prix results. Constructor and entrant identities remain distinct.
UI.circuitsLead: Explore the Grands Prix, recorded configurations and historical layout illustrations behind each circuit.
UI.noMatches: No matches. Try another part of the name or clear the search.
UI.noRecords: There are no records on this page.
UI.seasonsLead: Choose a year and explore its Grands Prix, drivers and constructors.
UI.noSeasons: Seasons have not been imported yet.
UI.seasonLead: Grand Prix calendar, results and driver–constructor relationships.
UI.noRaces: No races have been found for this season yet.
UI.lineupsLead: Relationships are reconstructed from race results, not contracts. A driver can race for several constructors in one season.
UI.noLineups: Lineups have not been imported yet.
UI.driverLead: The races, teams and seasons of a career.
UI.careerLead: Years and teams with recorded driver results. Multiple teams in one year are shown separately.
UI.noResults: Results have not been imported yet.
UI.seasonTeamsLead: Participation is reconstructed from race results. A driver may have raced for several constructors in one season.
UI.noTeams: Team history has not been imported yet.
UI.raceWins: {races, plural, one {# race} other {# races}} · {wins, plural, one {# win} other {# wins}}
UI.constructorLead: The cars, drivers and results behind the constructor.
UI.participationLead: Each marker is a season with recorded results. Gaps indicate no results in the imported archive.
UI.relationsLead: Only verified relationships with published sources are shown. Missing relationships do not establish an absence of historical continuity.
UI.noVerifiedRelations: Verified historical relationships have not been published yet.
UI.entrantLead: Historical relationships of a championship entrant. An asset transfer does not establish continuity of the legal entity or championship entry.
UI.noEntrantRelations: Verified relationships have not been published yet. This does not establish an absence of historical continuity.
UI.circuitCount: Grands Prix in the imported archive: {count}.
UI.circuitLayouts: Race and configuration records are grouped under this circuit’s F1DB identity. Select a recorded layout to explore its source facts.
UI.noCircuitRaces: No races have been found on this page yet.
UI.raceResultsLead: Order and points from F1DB. Retirement statuses and shared cars are preserved; these results are not final championship standings.
UI.scrollTable: You can scroll the table horizontally.
UI.lineageLead: Explore the teams behind Formula 1: their drivers, results and independently reviewed changes of name, ownership or operations.
UI.lineageCap: Up to 500 verified relationships are shown. A missing transition does not prove an absence of historical relationships.
UI.noPublishedRelations: Verified relationships have not been published yet. Data will appear after source review.
UI.networkLead: Select an arrow to inspect the transition type, year and primary source. The diagram shows verified relationships, not legal succession.
UI.networkScroll: On mobile, scroll the map horizontally. Zoom controls do not change the data.
UI.legalCaution: The relationship records the stated historical event and does not by itself establish legal succession.
UI.sourcesLead: Grid Atlas is an independent historical archive. These releases were registered when importing this database.
UI.noSources: Source releases have not been imported yet.
UI.sourceLimitations: The archive is limited to the imported release and is not updated live. Statistics derive from race results: driver-point sums are not official Constructors’ Championship totals. Sprints, dropped scores and historical scoring rules are not calculated separately.
UI.sourceIdentities: Constructors, entrants and legal organizations are distinct identities. Matching names do not prove continuity. Team history publishes only cited relationships after independent editorial approval; an empty graph means no relationships have been published.
UI.sourceLicense: F1DB data is licensed under <license>CC BY 4.0</license>. Grid Atlas selects fields from the source archive and derives summary statistics. A checksum confirms file integrity, not independent verification of every historical fact.
UI.loadingBody: Finding your place in Formula 1 history…
UI.errorBody: We couldn’t reach the archive. Your page address keeps your selection. Please try again.
UI.notFoundBody: This record is not in the archive.
UI.goldenArchiveScope: Based on recorded F1DB race results; race count is not an official starts count.
UI.goldenCareerScope: Only seasons with results are shown. A link indicates a result recorded for a constructor, not a contract or legal succession.
UI.goldenJourneyRelation: Race results with this constructor in {year}.
